entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane that broke into five shards long ago and has now been rejoined, leaving its people at war across the former shards.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara of stone walls and rigid castes, regarded as a sunnier land alongside Naya.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara of glass-and-steel sanctums, filigree halls and etherium-enhanced vedalken.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A dead shard of Alara ruled by necromancy and horrors.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara of warrior-clans, goblins, dragons and wrathful sky predators.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara of verdant jungles and great beasts, home to elves and the Nacatl.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A planeswalker whose fear-spreading message competes for Alara's future.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A white-aligned cat who, after the trauma of his brother's death, ignited his planeswalker spark and opened to red magic.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A Grixis monster that remembers being the most fearsome being on a young Alara and wants only to restore his old position.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: The cat people of Naya; some have joined the forces of Bant, and one soldier favors the older word leonin for his kin.

entities.name: Cylian
entities.description: The Naya elf kin among whom Bloodbraid Elf once lived.

events.summary: Across Alara, people face hard dilemmas and make choices that decide their fates in the rejoined plane and the inter-shard war.
events.quote: All over Alara, people are now facing just these kinds of dilemmas, and making the choices that determine their fates.

events.summary: Some Naya Nacatl join Bant and help defend the stone walls recently raised to keep Jund, Grixis and Esper out of Bant and Naya.
events.quote: helping defend the stone walls recently erected to keep Jund, Grixis, and Esper from encroaching on the sunnier lands of Bant and Naya

events.summary: Creatures are taken by summoning, mind control and force from one shard and recruited into the war on another.
events.quote: Through summoning, mind control, and sheer force, many creatures have been taken from one shard and recruited into the war on another.

events.summary: Malfegor, a Grixis monster, remembers when he was the most fearsome being on young Alara and seeks only to restore his lost position.
events.quote: He remembers the old days, when he was the most fearsome being on a young Alara

events.summary: Kings and queens of old Alara begin returning as spectral protectors for the soldiers in the plane's war.
events.quote: Kings and queens of old Alara have begun to return in spectral form, bearing magical protection for the soldiers in the plane's vast war.

events.summary: Ajani, traumatized by his brother's death, ignites his planeswalker spark and becomes open to red magic.
events.quote: Ajani, thanks to the trauma behind his brother's death, not only ignites his planeswalker spark but also becomes open to furious red magic

relations.quote: Malfegor is another Grixis monster who's trying to ply a strategy of business as usual.
